## Project details

- **Process:** Replace with 3D printing, laser cutting, CNC, electronics, woodworking or another process.
- **Materials:** Replace with the materials used.
- **Design tools:** Replace with the software, CAD tool or other design method used.

## What was made

Write two or three sentences explaining the project's purpose, important features and the design decision that mattered most.

## What was learned

Describe one challenge, test, revision or improvement. Explain what evidence led to the change rather than only saying that the project worked.

## Optional project files

Add a safe link to original design files only when sharing them is permitted. Delete this section when there is no public file.
